title: Microsoft Purview: Microsoft Graph APIs for archive mailboxes as EWS retires (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing background and EWS controls are supported. It distinguishes the government-cloud rollout target from current Graph availability tables and explicitly reports the conflicting import-response examples in Microsoft's preview documentation.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Graph access to main archive mailboxes.
claims.quote: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Graph access to auxiliary archive mailboxes.
claims.quote: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph.

claims.claim: The roadmap's goal is one seamless archive view despite data residing across auxiliary mailboxes.
claims.quote: The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes

claims.claim: Accessing an expanded folder can return HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect.
claims.quote: If the target resides in an auxiliary archive, the API returns a redirect response (such as `HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect`) with a redirect URL.

claims.claim: The app repeats a redirected request against the URL supplied by the service.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Exported items can individually return ErrorArchiveFolderMovedPermanently when stored in auxiliary archives.
claims.quote: When you export items from a mailbox that has autoexpanded archive folders, some items in the response might include an `ErrorArchiveFolderMovedPermanently` error instead of data.

claims.claim: An export routing error is recovered by reissuing the affected export against the supplied URL.
claims.quote: Reissue the export request for those items using the URL provided in the error message.

claims.claim: The EWS usage report is a read-only reporting surface.
claims.quote: The Exchange Web Services (EWS) usage report displays the SOAP actions used by each application calling EWS in your organization. It also shows the successful-call volume for each SOAP action.

| Application ID | The Microsoft Entra identifier for the registered application |
| SOAP Action | The specific Exchange Web Service SOAP action executed |

claims.claim: EWS usage data is collected and aggregated weekly.
claims.quote: Usage data is collected and aggregated weekly, not daily.

claims.claim: EWS usage can take up to 10 days to appear in the report.
claims.quote: It can take up to 10 days for usage to show in the report.
